feeds.title: Keeping Current Matters Blog
feeds.description: Today's real estate news and insights delivered to your inbox. Establish your credibility as a trusted agent by staying up to date on the housing market. At KCM, our mission is to change the way real estate advisors educate and serve their clients.

feeds.title: Michigan Institute of Real Estate Blog
feeds.description: Michigan Institute of Real Estate is the leader in Real Estate, Mortgage, Builder, Appraisal, Broker and Home Inspection Training Education Since 1985.

feeds.title: CCREEC Blog
feeds.description: The California Community Colleges Real Estate Education Center (CCCREEC) promotes excellent real estate education at the California Community Colleges. The Center promotes real estate and appraisal career education programs, encourages enrollment in California community college classes, supports faculty through professional development, and promotes real estate student scholarships and career opportunities.

feeds.title: Key Realty School Blog
feeds.description: Key Realty School has been offering real estate and business courses since 1991. The School helps thousands of licensed professionals each year advance their careers with high-quality courses and flexible enrollment options.

feeds.title: Indiana Real Estate Institute Blog
feeds.description: Indiana Real Estate Institute (IREI) prides itself on not only preparing students to pass the state exam, but to also help them build the best foundation possible to begin, continue, and grow their real estate career. We are educators, but we are also practicing real estate agents with many years of experience. We use that experience to explain real life scenarios that help our students grow their knowledge and excel in this industry.

feeds.title: Ken McElroy Blog
feeds.description: For over two decades, Ken McElroy has experienced great success in the real estate world through investment analysis, acquisitions, property management, and property development. Ken believes in sharing these successes, as well as his setbacks, to help educate and inspire investors to bridge the gap between where they are and where they want to be.

feeds.title: Stuart Chng Division Blog
feeds.description: Find out about the proven formula that Stuart Chng Division agents and team leaders apply to grow in their sales and team building exponentially for their real estate careers. Follow the real estate investment and career articles written by Stuart Chng for various media and publications.

feeds.title: VanEd Blog
feeds.description: VanEd is an online real estate school with over 23 years of education experience offering approved & regulated real estate courses for licensing, exam prep, & continuing education. The VanEd Real Estate Agent Blog - Keep up to date with the latest real estate news, get helpful real estate career tips, learn about VanEd course updates, and more.

feeds.title: Agent Real Estate Schools Blog
feeds.description: Agent Real Estate Schools was founded in 2013 formerly known as KW Real Estate Schools to provide a comprehensive pre-licensing course program along with ongoing real estate courses. Follow updates and new articles designed to help real estate newbies from Agent Real Estate Schools. Useful tips & insights to begin your real estate career.

feeds.title: Real Estate Exam Ninja Blog
feeds.description: Get Ready To Become a licensed realtor with Real Estate Exam Ninja. We give you all the tips available right when you need them. Our real estate exam prep is designed to simulate the actual test-taking experience in every way. Our real estate exam prep is designed to simulate the actual test-taking experience in every way. We know real estate math is hard.

feeds.title: Learning to Buy a Home Blog
feeds.description: With over sixteen years of teaching experience in home selling and home buying, we will get you started in the right direction. Buying a home is scary and selling a home is a major change. The purpose of our classes is to give you the education and the tools needed to move forward with confidence.

feeds.title: American Dream Real Estate School Blog
feeds.description: American Dream Real Estate School is a Colorado company dedicated to educating realtors. Whether you're beginning a new career and need licensing or continuing your pursuit of professional excellence through continuing education, American Dream Real Estate School offers the programs and individual courses to best prepare you to meet the challenges of your selected industry and your lifelong clients.

feeds.title: Real Estate School for Success Blog
feeds.description: The Real Estate School for Success is not a typical real estate training school. We are the #1 South Carolina Real Estate School providing courses to get your South Carolina Real Estate License, South Carolina Broker License, South Carolina Property Management License, South Carolina Appraisal License, Home Inspection License, and other Real Estate designations.

feeds.title: Alberta Real Estate School Blog
feeds.description: Raman Gakhal, CEO and Instructor at Alberta Real Estate School, has been active in the Real Estate Industry in many capacities for over 18 years. A Licensed Real Estate Professional herself, Raman has an in-depth understanding of Pre-licensing Courses. As an Instructor, she has achieved Success Ratio of over 95%.

feeds.title: Real Time Learn Blog
feeds.description: Real Time Learn breaks new ground by bringing the best of the classroom to the online environment, offering a variety of courses that combine dynamic video content with practical information specific to real estate in the Carolinas. We offer a new alternative to traditional text-based online education.

feeds.title: Greenwood Real Estate School Blog
feeds.description: Our approach is engaging and question-based, allowing students to ask questions based on experiences in the industry or scenarios where they weren't certain of the answer. Our instructors are certified and experienced, with a total of 64 plus years of knowledge to draw from. Using real-life scenarios and stories, we can bring the state-required material to life demonstrating the real-world application of the subject matter.

feeds.title: Polley Associates School of Real Estate Blog
feeds.description: Polley Associates is an approved education provider in Pennsylvania and New Jersey. We offer real estate sales and broker licensing, and appraisal trainee licensing courses, as well as continuing education for real estate and appraisal licensees. We provide additional non-credit courses on timely topics, designed to meet the specific needs of real estate and appraisal licensees.

feeds.title: Agent Professor's Blog
feeds.description: Agent Professor is an online real estate school that specializes in pre-licensing education for new real estate agents. We keep things simple and will guide you through the process of getting your Utah real estate license. Our course was created to educate our students in a fun and interactive manner.

feeds.title: McKissock Learning Blog
feeds.description: McKissock offers Continuing Education courses for Appraisers, Real Estate Agents, Engineers, & Other Licensed Professionals that are affordable & accredited. The McKissock Appraisal and Real Estate Blog provide career news, analysis, and articles to help professionals advance their careers.

feeds.title: My Tristar Academy Blog
feeds.description: Tristar Academy, a Real Estate Education Provider, was opened in 2015 to provide the best real estate education. The owners of Tristar Academy, Chris, Cindy, and Sarah Sinanan have over 75 years of combined experience! They dedicate their time to sharing their knowledge and experience within the real estate business with other agents and training instructors as well to carry on their legacy. At Tristar Academy, we believe that the real estate education process should be nothing less than a complete, solid understanding, and best education for you.

feeds.title: Realtors Real Estate School Blog
feeds.description: Welcome to RRES! There are many real estate schools to help you get started in your new career, but we think we're pretty special. Between our higher than average pass rate on the state licensure exam, our forty years of experience providing education and training to the Chicagoland real estate community, our flexible course options, and our deeply experienced, dedicated faculty, we've developed a program that's proven to work.
